kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أستنجب (form X)
# أَسْتَنْجِبُ (ʔastanjibu) /ʔas.tan.d͡ʒi.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَنْجَبَ (istanjaba)
# أُسْتَنْجَبُ (ʔustanjabu) /ʔus.tan.d͡ʒa.bu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَنْجَبَ (istanjaba)
# أَسْتَنْجِبَ (ʔastanjiba) /ʔas.tan.d͡ʒi.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَنْجَبَ (istanjaba)
# أُسْتَنْ
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
